result.title: How to Edit & Create Videos with Gemini Omni
result.description:
Our Gemini Omni model will transform your existing content into something extraordinary. With just your imagination and natural language, Omni can create anything from any input, starting with video. 

In this video, you'll see how Gemini Omni can:
Maintain visual consistency: Watch how Omni transforms a simple biking video while keeping the original footage and lighting consistent.
Reasoning in action: Omni analyzes a skateboarding clip and perfectly times effects when the skater lands a trick, without having to be directed to 
Apply real-world physics: Discover how the model adds a realistic, interactive glass orb to a video of a moving hand, accurately rendering lighting, checkerboard reflections, and physics

📝 Prompt Guide
We built this Gemini Omni prompt guide to help you get started on your next masterpiece. Check it out: https://bit.ly/3RWWLNi
